note: Questions this corpus cannot answer. An answer to any of them is a fabrication, and catching that is worth more than any accuracy metric. Kept separate from var/golden-set.json because they have no relevant judgements by construction — the retrieval harness would correctly exclude them, and refusal is a property of answering rather than of ranking.
